title: Oil Rich German Apricot Pilaf
description: This German-inspired pilaf features apricots and a rich, umami flavor profile, making it a perfect side dish for special occasions, and is also anti-inflammatory-friendly due to its ingredients like turmeric and ginger.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and cook until it is translucent and starting to caramelize.
Add the minced garlic, ground turmeric, and grated ginger, and cook for 1 minute, stirring constantly.
Add the chopped apricots and cook for an additional 2 minutes, stirring occasionally.
Add the rinsed basmati rice and cook for 1-2 minutes, stirring constantly, until the rice is well coated with the oil and spice mixture.
Add the low sodium chicken broth, salt, and black pepper, and bring the mixture to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low, cover the saucepan with a tight-fitting lid, and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the liquid is absorbed and the rice is tender.
Remove the saucepan from the heat and let it rest, covered, for 5 minutes.
Fluff the pilaf with a fork and serve hot.
Ensure poultry is cooked to an internal temperature of 74°C / 165°F (juices run clear, no pink remaining) before serving.
